role: summarize already-frozen empirical result and post-result diagnostics without changing any scientific decision

uncertainty_audits.synthesis: activity non-generalization remains robust when uncertainty is clustered by physical location; the small positive state point gain is not robust to within-endpoint resampling uncertainty

cross_taxon_negative_control.implication: the large diel transfer shift is not muskrat-specific and is compatible with a broader source/domain change

identifiability_limit.reason: geography, source domain, deployment metadata, annotation metadata and effective detection can shift together, while the fitted annotated stream fixes detection at one; observation-process nonstationarity can therefore be absorbed by the ecological activity channel

supported: The frozen E4 activity channel, as parameterized and transferred, worsened prediction under this heldout domain.
That negative activity transfer result is robust to deployment-block and physical-location-block uncertainty.
The failure magnitude is strongly concentrated in a source/location domain, but the negative direction also appears beyond that dominant source stratum.
The training-to-heldout diel-profile change is not muskrat-specific among eligible taxa in the same camera network.
The small positive state point gain is localized and remains uncertain under both ODSP block definitions.
not_supported: Activity is biologically irrelevant in general.
A causal eastward change in muskrat behavior.
A causal country, camera, observer, classifier, or source-network effect.
A superpopulation transfer claim across biological systems.
Retuning, rerunning, or switching the E4 backend.
